name: mods-manager
description: Keeps your mods current: pulls the mods folder from GitHub at session start (/updatemods to do it now), and a skill that installs mods you build.

autoUpdate.title: Pull the mods folder at session start
autoUpdate.description: Runs git pull --ff-only in the folder the mods are installed from, at most once per interval. New files load in the next session.
